mcqs.question: Which of the following is NOT a type of maintenance in software maintenance?
options: Corrective Maintenance
Adaptive Maintenance
Perfective Maintenance
Educational Maintenance

mcqs.question: What is the primary objective of Corrective Maintenance?
options: To improve the performance of software
To restore the software to its proper working condition
To adapt software to changes in its operating environment
To enhance the quality and usefulness of software
mcqs.answer: To restore the software to its proper working condition

mcqs.question: Which of the following is a characteristic of a good algorithm?
options: It is complex and difficult to understand
It is simple and easy to understand
It is efficient and reliable
It is slow and unreliable
mcqs.answer: It is simple and easy to understand

mcqs.question: What is the purpose of documentation in software development?
options: To improve the performance of software
To enhance the quality and usefulness of software
To assist users in understanding the software
To adapt software to changes in its operating environment
mcqs.answer: To assist users in understanding the software

mcqs.question: Which of the following is NOT a step in the Problem Solving Methodology?
options: Problem Definition
Problem Analysis
Solution Design
Problem Implementation

mcqs.question: What is the main objective of the Problem Analysis phase?
options: To determine what needs to be done
To decide how it should be done
To identify the problem and its requirements
To design a solution to the problem
mcqs.answer: To determine what needs to be done

mcqs.question: Which of the following is a characteristic of a good program?
options: It is complex and difficult to understand
It is simple and easy to understand
It is efficient and reliable
It is slow and unreliable
mcqs.answer: It is simple and easy to understand

mcqs.question: What is the purpose of testing in software development?
options: To improve the performance of software
To enhance the quality and usefulness of software
To detect defects and ensure that the software meets specified requirements
To adapt software to changes in its operating environment
mcqs.answer: To detect defects and ensure that the software meets specified requirements

mcqs.question: Which of the following is a type of error that occurs during runtime?
options: Syntax Error
Logical Error
Runtime Error
Compilation Error

mcqs.question: What is the primary objective of Perfective Maintenance?
options: To restore the software to its proper working condition
To adapt software to changes in its operating environment
To enhance the quality and usefulness of software
To improve the performance of software
mcqs.answer: To enhance the quality and usefulness of software
